stages.name: baseline protections
stages.detail: eleven signed device policies enforce recovery, civilian, friendly-force, protected-place, weather, assurance, replay, missing-policy, and expiry rules

stages.name: partial policy rollout
stages.detail: six canaries enforce the tighter 600 metre civilian floor while five devices safely retain the signed 150 metre floor

stages.name: completed policy rollout
stages.detail: all eleven guardians enforce the tightened fleet policy

stages.name: corrupted policy rejection
stages.detail: a damaged Fleet signature is rejected while the last verified policy continues to enforce locally

stages.name: guardian restart persistence
stages.detail: an on-disk sequence floor rejects the pre-restart envelope; a newer signed sync restores enforcement

stages.name: clock rollback
stages.detail: local time behind the persisted trusted high-water mark cannot revive earlier authority

stages.name: control-plane disconnect
stages.detail: a failed policy sync does not create permission; the cached verified policy continues to block locally

stages.name: audit-channel outage
stages.detail: failed receipt delivery never changes the local decision; the signed audit uploads after reconnection

stages.name: coherent snapshot rollback
stages.detail: Fleet detects a fully coherent older guardian snapshot from its signed receipt floor, holds authority, then requires explicit floor adoption plus a newer policy and lease

stages.name: signing-key lifecycle
stages.detail: a pinned overlap accepts the rotated key, then removal of the old key rejects later old-key envelopes without replacing active policy

stages.name: fleet-wide revocation
stages.detail: an authenticated no-policy response places every connected guardian into an explicit hold

stages.name: offline policy expiry
stages.detail: a disconnected guardian never treats stale authority as permission and uploads its signed receipt after reconnecting

stages.name: bounded offline continuity
stages.detail: an otherwise coherent cached snapshot loses authority when its signed Fleet continuity lease expires

stages.name: audit round trip
stages.detail: Fleet PostgreSQL returned 54 physical-interlock rows, including 54 signed governance certificates
